messages:
nina: quick note — discovered SDK vs REST parity issues during a sample-app smoke test: missing endpoint flags and differing defaults.

eli: which flags? can you repro?

nina: two things: 1) the JS SDK silently omits `max_output_tokens` when you pass null — REST treats null as unset, SDK drops the field altogether which changes server routing. 2) Python SDK uses a different default for `enable_structured_output` (True) vs REST default (False). onboarding sample assumed structured outputs.

pat: dropping `max_output_tokens` can change model choice in the router (short vs long context). that explains why some infra tests saw a different model.

nina: minimal repro (JS):
```js
// SDK v0.8.0
await client.chat.create({
  model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
  messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'hello'}],
  max_output_tokens: null
})
// server log: routed to short-context variant
```

eli: SDK serializer currently strips nulls to reduce payload size. but server expects explicit null for some signal. we need a whitelist of params where null != missing.

pat: and for structured_output default mismatch — sample-app-py sets no flag so SDK True kicks in and sample begins returning structured JSON blocks; onboarding docs show freeform text which confuses new users.

nina: created a short gist with logs: https://gist.github.com/nina/fff111 and filed DEVEX-4302.

devex-bot: Issue DEVEX-4302 created: "SDK payload parity: null vs missing + default flag drift" assigned to @eli.

eli: plan: 1) patch serializer to preserve explicit nulls for known router flags (max_output_tokens, model_hint, function_call) 2) align SDK defaults to server defaults for structured flags OR require explicit opt-in in sample apps 3) add contract tests comparing SDK payload -> REST payload for all chat params.

pat: also add a linter check for sample apps so quickstarts fail CI if they rely on SDK defaults that differ from REST.

nina: agreed. short-term workaround for maintainers: explicitly set flags in sample apps. adding a note in onboarding README.

eli: I'll open PR for the serializer fix and add a test matrix. tagging runtime and docs.

devex-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/881. CI pending.

pat: good catch — these little differences surface as big onboarding friction. thanks for digging in. :+1:
